BrochureContent.Content:
A four-bedroom detached bungalow, ideally positioned in a desirable rural setting on the edge of the peaceful village of Ardcath, has now come to the market.
Offering generous and well-proportioned living accommodation along with 4 double bedrooms, this family home is further enhanced by a single storey extension to the rear of the house to deliver a large open plan kitchen/dining/living space, a large utility room and a very useful additional WC/Shower room. Externally the property benefits from a newly installed on-site wastewater treatment system and percolation area.
Ardcath is a charming and tranquil village, offering a strong sense of community with its own church, primary school and quaint local country pub. The peaceful surroundings, combined with its excellent location, make this an appealing choice for families seeking a rural lifestyle while remaining within easy reach of a wide range of amenities.
The village is conveniently located with Duleek approximately 6.5km away, Drogheda town centre approximately 14.5km and Dublin International Airport approximately 35km. The property therefore offers the best of both worlds — a quiet countryside setting with excellent connectivity to nearby towns and Dublin.
Early viewing is highly recommended and is strictly by appointment through the sole agents, Sherry FitzGerald Lannon.
